name: Black Sword of Winter
body:
School conjuration (creation) [cold]; Level bloodrager 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 4, unchained summoner 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 0 ft.
Effect sword-like sheet of ice
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

A sword-shaped sheet of the blackest ice springs forth from your hand. You wield this weapon as a longsword, though you are treated as proficient, even if you are not normally proficient. Attacks with the black sword of winter are touch attacks. The blade deals 1d4 cold damage and 1d4 negative energy damage per 2 class levels per hit. This negative energy damage does not heal undead creatures. You cannot apply ability scores to this damage dealt or apply any feats that affect the weapon damage like Power Attack or Vital Strike.
